Content:
The authoritative creature model is CreatureDefinition (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Definition/CreatureDefinition.cs), ns ProceduralCreature.Definition. It is [Serializable] sealed, CurrentSchemaVersion=2, BodyId="body", and contains NO Unity scene objects, NO generated mesh/bone data, NO cached SDF arrays. Fields: SchemaVersion, SymmetryMode, Bounds (BoundsDefinition), Generation (GenerationSettings), Body (BodySpline), Forward (Vector3, default Vector3.forward), Parts (List<CreaturePart>). Methods: Clone(), CreateHierarchyIndex(), FindPart(id), GetChildren(parentId), HasParentCycle, AddPart, RemovePart, ClonePartAsChild(sourceId,newParentId). AddPart does NOT canonicalize/validate - that happens at the mutation boundary.

CreaturePart ([Serializable] sealed, immutable-by-convention): Id (stable slug, never list-position-derived), DisplayName, ParentId (null=root), PartType, Transform (TransformData), Shape (ShapeDefinition), Appearance (AppearanceDefinition), nullable Limb (LimbChain), nullable MeshGeometry, MirrorAcrossSymmetryPlane, nullable ParentAttachment (BodySurfaceAnchor). Methods Clone(), CloneAsDuplicate() (fresh Id via PartIdGenerator).

ENUMS (ns ProceduralCreature.Definition): PartType (Body=0, Limb, Leg, Arm, Tail, Foot, Root, Part, Eye, Hand; serialized by NAME so numeric value stable); SymmetryMode (None=0, MirrorAcrossXAxis=1; generation-time-only - a mirrored part is ONE Parts entry, mirror produced by SDF compiler + skeleton inference as derived state, never written back); ShapeType (Sphere, Capsule, Box, Ellipsoid); ShapeAxis (X,Y,Z capsule local axis); GeometryType (Implicit=0 SDF, MeshAsset=1 pre-authored mesh by key, Procedural=2 not yet implemented; orthogonal to PartType).

DATA STRUCTS: TransformData (Position/Rotation/Scale, parent-local; IsFinite, Quantized - position/scale to 4dp, rotation normalized); ShapeDefinition (Type, legacy PrimarySize, Radius, CapsuleAxis, CapsuleHeight, EllipsoidRadii, BoxHalfExtents, SmoothBlendRadius smooth-min blend 0=hard; WithLegacyDefaults, IsFinite, HasValidParameters); AppearanceDefinition (BaseColor, NoiseSeed, NoiseScale, MaterialKey optional stable submaterial name - NEVER UnityEngine.Object; Body owns gradient appearance and never carries a material key); BoundsDefinition (MaxX/Y/Z hard authoring bounds default 4; Contains checks [-Max,+Max]); GenerationSettings (VoxelsPerUnit default 16; EstimateVoxelCount vs EstimateSampleCount - sample count is what validator budget guards).

GEOMETRY ATTACHMENT: GeometryAttachment (Offset/Orientation/Scale in part local frame, placement intent); MeshGeometry (MeshAssetKey stable name + Attachment; mutually exclusive with Limb - validator-enforced; DNA never stores UnityEngine.Object). PartIdGenerator format "part_"+8 lowercase hex.

SUPPORTING: LimbChain/LimbJoint/ThicknessProfile, BodySpline/BodySample/BodySurfaceAnchor, BodyVerticalGradientAppearance, adapters GradientAdapter/CurveAdapter/ThicknessCurveAdapter, CreaturePartHierarchyIndex, CreaturePartWorldTransformResolver, BodyFrameResolver.

CANONICALIZATION (DefinitionCanonicalizer, static): Canonicalize(CreatureDefinition) returns a NEW definition (input not mutated). Does NOT validate and is NOT a repair pass - canonicalizing invalid DNA throws DomainException (callers validate first). Quantizes Body spline sample positions+radius, Forward (normalized first), each part Transform, mesh GeometryAttachment offset/scale (orientation via QuantizeUtil.CanonicalizeQuaternion), calls shape.WithLegacyDefaults(). Limb chains: quantize each joint position + BlendRadius, order thickness keys; throws on non-finite/negative/no-joints. Body appearance: quantize gradient keys + curve keys, ORDER keys by non-decreasing time. Stable part ordering: depth-first from BodyId (children sorted by Id ordinal), remaining disconnected parts appended sorted by Id.

TOLERANCES (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Common/GenerationTolerances.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Common): QuantizationDecimalPlaces=4; ScalarComparisonEpsilon=1e-3f; MinScaleComponent=1e-3f; BodySpacingTolerance=1e-3f; MaxBodySampleCount=1024; MinLimbJointCount=2; MaxLimbJointCount=64; MinLimbSegmentLength=1e-3f; LimbRootAtOriginTolerance=1e-3f; MaxVoxelBudget=16777216L. Quantize uses Math.Round(value,4,MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero). QuantizeUtil: Quantize(float/Vector3), CanonicalizeQuaternion(q).

VALIDATION (DefinitionValidator, static): Validate(CreatureDefinition) returns ValidationResult; throws DomainException only on null (programmer error). REPORT-ONLY, never repairs. Run order: ValidateSchemaVersion, ValidateBody, ValidateBodyAppearance, ValidateBounds, ValidateGenerationBudget, ValidateDuplicateIds, ValidateParentsAndCycles, ValidatePartTypes, ValidateTransformsAndShapesAndAppearance, ValidateLimbChains, ValidateMeshGeometry, ValidateResolvedEnvelope. The resolved-envelope stage re-resolves geometry through shared CreaturePartWorldTransformResolver + ResolvedBody/ResolvedLimb derivations to catch nested origins out of bounds. Severities (ValidationSeverity): Info=0, Warning=1 (non-blocking), Error=2 (BLOCKS generation - any Error means don't generate). ValidationCode has 42 values (NullPart, DuplicatePartId, ReservedPartId, MissingParent, ParentCycle, ..., ResolvedMeshAttachmentOutOfBounds). ValidationResult.IsValid == true iff no Error. Issues sorted deterministically by PartId then Code then Severity (order-independent).

SERIALIZATION (ns ProceduralCreature.Serialization): IDnaSerializer (Serialize canonicalizes first, throws DomainException if not finite/valid; Deserialize parses structurally only, does NOT validate - caller must run DefinitionValidator). DnaDeserializationException for structurally malformed JSON. JsonDnaSerializer (default): Serialize = Canonicalize -> CanonicalJsonWriter.Write; Deserialize = MiniJsonReader.Parse -> manual tree-walk. Rejects schema v1 explicitly. CanonicalJsonWriter: fixed key order, fixed numeric formatting, fixed part order; FLOATS ALWAYS "F4" with InvariantCulture (never R/G) = heart of byte-stability. MiniJsonReader: dependency-free recursive-descent parser (Dictionary/List/string/double/bool/null).

ROUND-TRIP/BYTE-STABILITY: asserted in JsonDnaSerializerTests (RoundTrip_ReconstructsEquivalentDefinition, Serialize_IsByteStableAcrossRepeatedCalls, Serialize_IsStableAcrossPartInsertionOrder, SaveLoadSave_ProducesByteStableJson, Deserialize_RejectsV1Explicitly) and Limb/MeshGeometry/MaterialKey variants. Gate: "Save -> load -> canonical-save produces byte-stable canonical JSON for supported definitions." Mesh geometry serializes as part field meshGeometry {meshAssetKey, attachment{offset,orientation,scale}}; limb as limbChain {joints[{id,position}], blendRadius, thicknessProfile{keys[{t,value}]}}; part appearance {baseColor{r,g,b,a}, noiseSeed, noiseScale, materialKey}; Body appearance {topGradient, bottomGradient, verticalCurve} with {mode, colorKeys[{time,color}], alphaKeys[{time,alpha}]}; curve {keys[{time,value,inTangent,outTangent}]}. Legacy verticalOffset migrates exactly (3-key curve). DisplayName preserved verbatim; null round-trips as null.

INVARIANTS: symmetry generation-time-only; CreatureDefinition/Part contain no generated state; stable Ids never change on reorder/save/load/regeneration; single mutation boundary in editor; canonicalization only at commit/serialization; shape inert when part has Limb or MeshGeometry; reserved PartType Body/Root not authorable in v2; Hand serialized by name; limb root joint at local origin (Joints[0] ~ Vector3.zero) - Transform is single placement authority (ADR-001).
Title: CreatureCreator Authoritative DNA Model, Canonicalization, Validation, Serialization
